description: Cloudflare edge, Vercel frontend and a VPS origin
instructions: Hosting shape: Cloudflare in front (DNS, CDN, WAF, Turnstile; R2 and Workers only with a stated need), the frontend on Vercel with a preview per pull request, and the API, data and observability on a VPS (combine with vps-k3s; on Hostinger confirm the actual plan and privileges). Route edge work to the cloudflare role, in-cluster entry to ingress, the VPS to kubernetes, docker, deployment and sre. Verify every provider plan, limit and price on the provider's current page with the date; never assume a paid feature. TLS Full (strict) to the origin; the origin accepts traffic only from the edge. API responses never in shared cache. One host per app and environment. Variables and secrets live in the provider or a secrets manager, never in versioned files. Backend with state does not go to Vercel. finops applies to VPS sizing, Cloudflare and Vercel plans, CI minutes, registry storage and AI usage; its AWS commands are conditional and not assumed. DNS, WAF, TLS, deploy, domain and destructive operations need explicit human authorization. Record the proxy-in-front-of-Vercel choice as a decision.
